$comment: Advisories consciously accepted, with the reason they do not apply to this app.
The audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs) fails on every high/critical finding that
is NOT listed here, and fails on any entry past its reviewBy date — so an
exception rots into a build failure instead of quietly becoming permanent.
An entry is a claim that the code path is unreachable here, never that the

exceptions.title: RSC Mode CSRF Bypass Allows Action Execution Before 400 Response
reason: Affects React Router's RSC (React Server Components) mode. This app is a
client-only SPA: it mounts <BrowserRouter> in src/main.tsx, builds with
'tsc -b && vite build', and has no SSR/RSC entry point (no renderToString,
anywhere in src/). The vulnerable server-action path is never constructed.
npm's suggested remediation is a DOWNGRADE to react-router-dom@7.11.0, which
would reintroduce the open-redirect, XSS, constructor-injection and DoS
advisories that 7.18.1 fixes. Accepting this one is strictly safer.
exceptions.revisitIf: the app ever adopts SSR, RSC, or a framework mode (Remix/react-router 'framework' mode)
